text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Monday it had offered to acquire Hugoton Energy Corp for $15 a share.
Belco said the companies had signed an exclusivity agreement through July 11.
Of the purchase price, $5 would be cash and $10 would be in Belco common stock.
"The offer is subject both to due dilligence and to a mutually satisfactory definitive agreement," said Belco Chairman Robert Belfer.

Belco said the proposal provides that the number of shares of Belco will be calculated assuming a market price of $23 and will be increased or decreased as applicable by up to 10 percent depending on the market price of Belco stock at the time of consummation of the deal.
Belco previously announced the purchase of about three million shares of Hugoton at $10.50 a share, representing a 14.9 percent stake.
The combination of the merger offer and the previously acquired shares would result in a blended cost to Belco of $14.33 per share for Hugoton, Belco said.
